domain_test: The deciding quantity is the number of distinct people across sources, the object of entity resolution: a linkage service's pairwise findings resolved into persons consistently with each source's own deduplication, because pairwise matches are not transitive; the field resolves them by constrained clustering over the match graph, and replacing that with the generic merge (connected components) changes every Continuum's count. Put another setting's nouns in and the task still turns on resolving pairwise matches into entities, which is this task type's own analysis rather than a backdrop for it.

driver: The decisive quantity is a count of distinct units across several lists that each hold a unit once, joined only by pairwise findings; a record carrying fewer identifiers matches several units at once, so merging every chain of findings joins units one list keeps apart, and the count follows only when the findings are resolved so that no group holds two rows of one list, each chain cut at its weakest finding.
driver_concrete: Four Continuums of Care's HMIS exports, a domestic violence coalition's database, a homeless clinic's patients and a city outreach app's clients are linked by a state linkage unit that reports scored pairwise findings; outreach contacts, coalition survivors and street intakes carrying only a birth year link to every client of that name, year and sex, so merging every chain of links joins two clients one source keeps apart; resolving the findings strongest first so no person holds two records of one source, cutting each such chain at its weakest link, restores them.
stump: Merging every record the linkage unit linked, directly or through other records, files the region at 39,874 people and the downtown Continuum at 17,644 people and 7,964,889 dollars, 28,815 dollars short, because a record carrying only a year of birth links to every client of that name, year and sex, so 225 merged groups hold two records one source keeps apart.

lineage.driver: Small-area counts published with added noise and then forced to non-negative whole numbers that add up to the next level's count are pushed up where the true count is near zero and down where it is large, so an area assembled from the sparse cells of groups it shares with dense cells collects the drift; it has to be built from the groups' own counts and split inside a cut group by a measure the release leaves exact.
lineage.niche: fusing a formally private census release's nested block, block group and tract tables with the county's housing register into census-day counts of older residents for senior-services provider areas whose boundaries cut block groups at the town edges, for the state aging formula's filing
lineage.stump: Summing the release's block counts over each provider area's blocks files North Kelvane at 850 residents aged 60 and over where it held about 700, and every rural area 4 to 21 per cent high and both towns 1 to 3 per cent low, because noise-infused counts forced to be non-negative and consistent with their block group drift from the dense town blocks into the sparse rural blocks of the block groups the boundaries cut.
lineage.fate: spent at stage 4 on 2026-10-21: the determinism judge returned NOT_DETERMINISTIC (competing_defensible_answer, SEND_BACK): the release's block counts summed over each area were a defensible reading because nothing shipped separated them from the housing-unit split of the block groups' counts; both isolated readers missed the call but kept every ask figure (the replay cap and the prior-number death chain sat on the careful path); re-rooted fresh by the author's rule (no retirement)
